articles.title: U.S. and China Agree to AI Hotline After Summit
articles.summary: After a three-day summit in Washington, the U.S. and China agreed to create a channel for AI-related incidents and keep trade talks going. Trump said the U.S. is 'leading by a lot' in AI and won't slow down.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV Celebrates Massive Open-Air Mass in Paris
articles.summary: An estimated 700,000 people attended Pope Leo XIV's open-air Mass at Place de la Concorde in Paris. He praised young people as 'today's Church' and rode down the Champs-Élysées in his popemobile.

articles.title: Supreme Court Revives Controversial Voter Citizenship Check
articles.summary: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to restart a revamped data system called SAVE, which checks voters' citizenship. The system has mistakenly flagged eligible voters. The legal fight continues.
